Espacio Urbano Gran Avenida

Urban shopping centre on Gran Avenida in San Miguel, with convenient metro line 2 access. Practical for quick services, supermarket and clothing on the city's southern axis.

Best for

  • San Miguel residents
  • Quick shopping on Gran Avenida
  • Metro L2 access

Not ideal for

  • Tourists
  • Those looking for a large-format mall

Getting there

Close to Line 2 stations along Gran Avenida.

Recommended time: 1 hour
